Fresh Seafood and Fantastic Service in June
Jun 2026 • Solo
We had a really great time at this seafood restaurant with my friends back in June! The seafood was incredibly fresh and the staff were so enthusiastic and helpfull about recommending dishes. The atmosphere was very unique and the prices were reasonable for the quality you get. Everything we ordered tasted amazing and you could tell they use fresh ingredients. The service was quick and attentive throughout our meal. I would definitely recommend this place if you're looking for good seafood in Da Nang. It's a perfect spot for groups and the portions are generous. Overall a wonderful dining experience that exceeded our expectations!
